cards.text: It's the third year of Cyrus, king of Persia. A message is revealed to Daniel, also called Belteshazzar, one of the young men taken from Judah to Babylon long ago (Daniel 1:1-7). The message is true, and the understanding of it comes to him in a vision.

cards.question: This true message is revealed to Daniel in the third year of Cyrus. What is it about?

cards.text: Now Daniel picks up the story himself: "In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three full weeks." Not three days, friend. THREE. FULL. WEEKS.

cards.question: During his three full weeks of mourning, Daniel keeps eating rich food the same as always.

cards.text: No rich food, no meat or wine, and he doesn't anoint himself with oil until the three weeks are done. Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, Daniel's standing on the bank of a great river.

cards.question: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, Daniel is standing on the bank of the great river, the ___.

cards.text: Daniel lifts up his eyes, and behold: a certain man dressed in linen, with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist. Friend, my fanciest outfit is a CLEAN apron, and this man shows up wearing GOLD.

cards.question: The man in linen that Daniel sees by the river looks just like any ordinary man.

cards.text: "His body was like beryl, his face like the brilliance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of polished bronze, and his voice like the sound of a multitude." Friend, I pull my chef's hat down over my eyebrows when the oven light clicks on, and this man's FACE is like lightning.

Here's the thing: only Daniel sees the vision, and the men with him don't see a thing. But a great terror falls on them anyway, and friend, that's the WORST kind of scared, scared of something you can't even see.

cards.question: The men with Daniel don't see the vision, but a great terror falls on them. What do they do?

answers.text: They call out to the man

cards.question: Left alone gazing at this great vision, what happens to Daniel's strength?

answers.text: It carries him after his men

cards.text: None left, friend. His face grows deathly pale, and then he hears the sound of the man's words.

cards.question: As Daniel listens to the sound of the man's words, he stays standing on the bank of the river.

cards.text: Instead he falls into a deep sleep, face to the ground. Then suddenly a hand touches him and sets him trembling on his hands and knees.
Then he hears, "Daniel, you are a man who is highly precious."

cards.question: The voice tells Daniel to consider carefully the words to come, and to stand up. What reason does it give for standing up?

answers.text: He has now been sent to Daniel
The three weeks are not over

cards.question: Once he's told to stand, Daniel stays down on his hands and knees.

cards.text: "Do not be afraid, Daniel," he says. Daniel set out to understand and to humble himself before his God, and his words were heard, which is more than I can say for my last three group chats.

cards.question: Daniel's words weren't heard until his three weeks of mourning were over.

cards.text: From day ONE, and he says he's come in response to those words. But Daniel's been mourning three full weeks, so what took so long?

cards.question: Daniel's words were heard on day one, but the one sent to him arrives after three weeks. What opposed him?

answers.text: The prince of the kingdom of Persia
The rulers of the land of Babylon
The armies of the king of Egypt

cards.text: Opposed for twenty-one days. Do the math, friend: that's three full weeks, the same stretch Daniel spent mourning, and I start pacing when the oven timer says three MINUTES.

cards.question: The prince of the kingdom of Persia opposes the one sent to Daniel for twenty-one days. Then ___ comes to help him.

cards.text: Michael, one of the chief princes, comes to help, for the one speaking had been left there with the kings of Persia. Friend, when I need backup in this bakery, the best I've got is a spatula that's scared of the mixer.

cards.question: The one sent to Daniel has finally made it to him. What has he come to explain?

answers.text: What will happen to Daniel's people in the latter days
Why Daniel's men ran away and hid by the river
How Daniel should bring his three weeks of mourning to an end

cards.question: While the one sent to him is speaking these words, what happens to Daniel?

answers.text: He gets up and walks away

cards.text: While he's speaking, Daniel sets his face toward the ground and goes SPEECHLESS, and friend, the only thing that leaves me speechless is a perfect batch on the first try. Then one with the likeness of a man touches Daniel's lips.

cards.question: Once his lips are touched, Daniel opens his mouth and speaks.

cards.text: Daniel says, "My lord, because of the vision, I am overcome with anguish, and I have no strength." Then he asks how he, the lord's servant, can even speak with him, with no strength and no breath left in him.

cards.question: When Daniel says he has no strength or breath left, the one with the likeness of a man leaves him to recover on his own.

cards.text: He tells Daniel not to be afraid, calls him highly precious, and says, "Peace be with you! Be strong now; be very strong!" Strong, then VERY strong, friend, like a gym coach who is not taking no for an answer.

cards.question: After being told to be very strong, what does Daniel say to the one with the likeness of a man?

answers.text: Speak because you have strengthened me
Give me time to catch my breath
Let me rest until the morning

cards.text: Daniel's strengthened, and he says, "Speak, my lord, for you have strengthened me." Then comes the question that makes every adult's stomach drop, friend: "Do you know why I have come to you?"

cards.question: The one speaking with Daniel says he must return at once. What for?

answers.text: To fight against the prince of Persia
To bring back the men who hid
To guard the bank of the Tigris

cards.text: Once he's gone forth, behold, the prince of Greece will come, which is like pulling one batch out and hearing the NEXT timer already going off. But first, he'll tell Daniel what is inscribed in the Book of Truth.

cards.question: Against the prince of Persia and the prince of Greece, the one speaking to Daniel says no one has the courage to support him except ___, Daniel's prince.

cards.text: Then he says, "And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, stood up to strengthen and protect him." That's Darius the Mede, who received the kingdom back in Daniel 5:31, and the Book of Truth is about to open, friend, so stay close, because this story's not done.

findings.problem: After quoting Daniel, the card introduces “Do you know why I have come to you?” only with “Then comes the question.” It does not identify the one speaking with Daniel as the speaker before quoting him as “I,” leaving the quote's attribution unclear after a sentence about Daniel speaking.

rule.text: **Who's speaking.** When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first.
